title: isTrackerPhase4Worker
responsibility: Identify one Phase 4 module or batch worker item so the digest can collapse it.

inputs.name: isTrackerPhase4Worker.title
inputs.description: Item title; a trailing p4 unit id or a Phase 4 prefix marks a candidate.

inputs.name: isTrackerPhase4Worker.owner
inputs.description: Item owner; a Haiku, Luna or worker name marks a Phase 4 titled item.

outputs.name: isTrackerPhase4Worker
outputs.description: True for one module or batch worker item.
